scientific_integrity: All analytic claims are proved in RESULT.md; checker.py performs exact rational finite diagnostics, not an independent proof of universal quantifiers. No independent audit or validation performed.
scientific_limitations: Independent noninteracting Schaefer stocks, constant effort and catchability, positive net growth and exact normalized indicators. The three-stock construction is not field calibrated. Historical priority is provisional: Jensen (1991) full text and some related multispecies assessments were not available for complete comparison. The model does not address noisy measurements, interactions, extinction or variable effort.
title: Two-stock rigidity and a sharp three-stock onset of repeated aggregate catch-rate reversals
